exposure: Singleton breech vs. twin breech vs. twin cephalic
cohort: 491 consecutive live births (after 23+0 weeks gestation) delivered through cesarean section with at least 1 baby with noncephalic presentation in single or twin pregnancies from April 2013 to October 2018
finding: Breech presentation, both in singleton and twin pregnancies, was found to be an independent risk factor for DDH, while twin pregnancy itself was not.
mod_finding: Breech presentation is an independent risk factor for developmental dysplasia of the hip in twin pregnancies, but twin pregnancy itself is not a risk factor.
